transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-10-21 09:30 PDT
Duration: 45 minutes
Attendees: Alicia Park (Redwood AE), Sandeep Rao (Redwood SE), Maya Chen (Redwood), Tom Reyes (CTO - Nimbus), Priya Kapoor (Infra), Liam O'Connor (Security), Sarah Wu (ML)

Summary:
Quick sync on Redwood Private VPC pilot: networking checks, routing issues observed in last 48h, control-plane upgrade plan, perf numbers from yesterday's run, and next steps for final validation.

Topics:
- Networking / TGW peering / firewall rules
- Control plane upgrade (v1.8 -> v1.9) and maintenance window
- Agent/sidecar connectivity and KV cache warmup
- Perf numbers: p95 latency, throughput, token cost approximation
- Security docs and compliance questions

Transcript:
00:00 Alicia: okay, good morning everyone, thanks for joining the weekly POC sync, um we've got about 45 minutes on the calendar. quick roll call?
00:06 Tom: Tom here, Priya here, Liam and Sarah with me.
00:10 Alicia: great, thanks. Sandeep, Maya, you want to kick off with the network findings?
00:15 Sandeep: yeah, sure. so yesterday we saw intermittent failures between the control plane and the agent in AZ-b, looks like roughly every 10-15 minutes a small flurry of errors. our logs show tcp resets on the sidecar, likely due to an MTU mismatch or a path MTU in the transit gateway.
00:34 Priya: yeah we saw that, and our cloud team flagged a couple of overloaded routes on the TGW attachment for the staging VPC. we increased the route table limit but still saw spikes.
00:44 Sandeep: right, one oddity - the KV cache warmup was slower on node-2, so first-token latency spiked a bit. might be related to packet fragmentation, or maybe the agent restarted during the warmup.
00:58 Sarah: just to confirm, when you say KV cache, is that the K-V cache in the Redwood runtime? sometimes the transcript system calls it K V cache so i want to clarify.
01:05 Sandeep: yes, KV cache for the model context used by the runtime.
01:08 Liam: from a security POV the control-plane calls are over the private link, right? we need the audit logs to show successful TLS handshakes and mTLS cert validation.
01:16 Maya: correct, control plane is private, we use mTLS and our stack integrates with customer KMS for keys. we'll add the TLS handshake entries to the logs we share.
01:25 Tom: performance numbers? yesterday's perf run - how did latency look at p95 for the prompt set we gave you?
01:32 Sandeep: so for the 20k requests run we did yesterday on the staging cluster: median was ~110ms token latency, p95 around 420ms for a 1024-token workload with our quantized variant. note that the first-token latency for cold sessions was up to 1.2s on node-2.
01:50 Sarah: that's inline with expectations but we worry about tail for user-facing flows. any levers?
01:55 Sandeep: yes, levers are prefix caching, pre-warm on deployment, and increasing small-batch continuous batching settings. we've got config suggestions in the bench spreadsheet.
02:07 Alicia: also higher priority is fixing the networking blips - even with batching the reconnects cause request retries which amplify cost.
02:16 Priya: on the TGW peering, our cloud team will check attachment health. quick question: does Redwood require specific SG egress rules or just allowlist IPs for the control plane?
02:26 Maya: prefer both - allowlist IPs for the control-plane endpoints and SG rules to allow outgoing 443/8443 to those IPs. we'll share the minimal set.
02:36 Alicia: action here - we'll post a firewall rules doc and IP list by end of day.
02:40 Tom: cool. next, control-plane upgrade - you mentioned v1.9 has a kernel fix for agent reconnects?
02:47 Sandeep: yeah v1.9 includes a patch for the agent's socket churn and also improves the backoff logic. we recommend a canary on two nodes, then a rolling upgrade. estimated downtime: brief controller restart but agents reconnect within 30-60s.
03:01 Liam: we need a maintenance window and a rollback plan in case of cert issues.
03:06 Alicia: plan is to schedule maintenance 2026-10-28 02:00-03:00 UTC for staging full upgrade, with canary on 2026-10-27 in a restricted set. we'll share rollback steps.
03:17 Priya: please make sure the upgrade won't change the encryption hooks or KMS flow. our compliance team will want a tech note.
03:24 Maya: confirmed, no KMS flow changes; it's a runtime/agent patch only. we'll provide a brief compliance note.
03:30 Tom: on routing - any config changes we need?
03:33 Sandeep: small suggested TGW route prioritization and a per-attachment MTU setting to avoid fragmentation. also ensure UDP/ICMP path MTU discovery isn't blocked.
03:44 Priya: i'll open a ticket with our networking team to validate MTU and TGW attachments.
03:47 Sarah: one more perf question: token cost delta with quantization vs float32. did you produce a cost estimate?
03:52 Sandeep: ballpark - quantized model reduces GPU memory and token compute so our per-token inference cost drops ~28% on this workload; the bench sheet has the math, we'll link.
04:04 Tom: can you post the bench sheet link in slack after the call?
04:07 Alicia: yes we'll post it in #nimbus-redwood and also attach security docs.
04:12 Liam: security items - SOC2 scoping question: do you keep audit logs in customer region or in Redwood's analytics? we need to know retention and access controls.
04:21 Maya: for Private customers we support pushing audit logs to your logging endpoint; out of box we retain logs for 30 days in redwood analytics but for VPC/private we can route them to your S3/CloudWatch. we'll send the security PDF.
04:36 Tom: anything else on integrations - SSO/SAML?
04:39 Alicia: for pilot we rely on our demo SSO but production will use your SAML metadata; we have a config guide.
04:45 Sarah: can we do a short run with a live user flow next week to validate tail latency?
04:49 Alicia: yes let's schedule a 1-hour run; how's 2026-10-23 14:00 UTC?
04:55 Tom: that works for us.
04:57 Priya: noted.
05:00 Alicia: ok quick recap and next steps - we'll share firewall IPs and bench sheet today, Sandeep will collect logs from node-2 and node-3 and post them, Priya will open cloud networking ticket, we'll schedule canary upgrade and full maintenance window next week.
05:16 Tom: perfect. thanks everyone.
05:18 Alicia: thanks all, meeting adjourned.

References:
- Security doc (to be shared): link to internal doc (redwood/shared/security_private_vpc.pdf)
